degree_rationale: How some body members are hidden, some visible — corresponding to the Father (hidden), the two ships of light (visible eyes), the soul (mistreated/touched), Jesus (revealing tongue). Treats the mechanism of correspondence between bodily structure and divine arrangement.
direction_rationale: West-turn at spiritual: the correspondences are now established — the body's hidden/visible members as ultimating signs of the Father's structure. The completing seal of correspondence.
grand_man_function: Spiritual correspondence-seal — the body-as-mirror of the Father's hidden/visible structure.
title: How some members of the body are hidden and some visible (correspondence to Father)
